basic_profile.bio: An arcade aficionado from the Midwest, I spend my downtime exploring vintage pinball machines and sharing my love for retro gaming online. By day, I'm a software developer, and by night, you can find me diving into the latest mobile games or scoping out deals on Aliexpress. I'm single and enjoy late-night gaming sessions when the world is quiet, typically between 10 PM and 2 AM. I've been a Redditor for nearly a decade, mostly lurking but occasionally sharing my thoughts on gaming and more.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science and a childhood spent in arcades, I have a solid foundation in both technology and gaming. My knowledge of retro games comes from years of collecting and repairing old machines, while my tech skills are honed through my day job and online courses.
